## History

Before relocating to the [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island), James A. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). He had married [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott to fulfill a dying promise to his sister, but the couple eventually separated when [Emily](../character/emily.md) forced him to choose between her and [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), a parrot gifted to him by his dying brother. Years after their separation, [Emily](../character/emily.md) unexpectedly arrived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) looking for James, leaving him secretly glad to be reunited with his wife.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), +1 more_
